front.title: Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy) over the Agent Transfer Protocol

abstract.t: This document specifies how the Personal Agent Protocol (PAP, also called Poppy) is carried over the Agent Transfer Protocol (AGTP). Poppy defines how a personal agent acting for one person discovers a company, opens a session, signs the person in with OAuth, and acts through the company's APIs, website, or agent. Poppy 1.0 specifies these exchanges over HTTPS. AGTP is a transfer protocol for agent traffic that carries agent identity, authority scope, delegation, and signed attribution as headers of every request and response. This document maps each Poppy exchange onto an AGTP method and path, binds the Poppy client identifier and User ID to the AGTP identifier stack, states which Poppy functions AGTP headers supply and which remain with OAuth over HTTPS, and records the open issues the mapping raises. It defines no change to Poppy.
